title: Implement pagination controls
userStory: As a user, I want pagination with page numbers and configurable page size so that I can navigate through history efficiently.
acceptanceCriteria: Page size dropdown: 10, 25, 50, 100 items per page
Page size preference persisted to localStorage
Page number buttons: First, Prev, [1] [2] [3] ... [N], Next, Last
Ellipsis for large page ranges (show first 2, current ±1, last 2)
Display Showing X-Y of Z results
Disabled states for prev/next at boundaries
